lines.zh: 每一步都踩下去半尺，沙子替我埋脚。
lines.en: Each step sinks half a foot, and the sand buries my feet.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，沙丘会低一寸。
lines.en: Where I pass, the dune drops an inch.

lines.zh: 石头在膝盖里磨，声音很闷。
lines.en: Stone grinds inside my knees with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我不绕沙丘，我直接跨过去。
lines.en: I do not go around dunes; I step over them.

lines.zh: 风把沙子吹到我身上，又吹走一点。
lines.en: Wind blows sand onto me and takes a little away.

lines.zh: 我的脚印第二天就被填平了。
lines.en: My footprints are filled in by the next day.

lines.zh: 这条沙脊太软，我走得慢。
lines.en: This sand ridge is too soft, so I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 沙从指缝漏下去，我懒得捡。
lines.en: Sand leaks between my fingers and I do not bother.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你十步，但我懒得数。
lines.en: One of my steps is ten of yours; I do not count.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的影子烤得贴在沙上。
lines.en: The sun bakes my shadow flat against the sand.

lines.zh: 我走得沉，连蜥蜴都提前跑了。
lines.en: I walk heavy, so even the lizards leave early.

lines.zh: 岩石缝里的沙子，走起来像咬合。
lines.en: Sand in the rock seams grinds like teeth closing.

lines.zh: 我转身要先挪左脚，再挪右脚。
lines.en: To turn, I move the left foot, then the right.

lines.zh: 沙漠没有路，只有我踩出来的。
lines.en: The desert has no roads, only the ones I press out.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，沙丘塌了一角。
lines.en: I lift a foot and a dune corner caves in.

lines.zh: 我走过干河床，沙响很大。
lines.en: I cross a dry riverbed and the sand rasps.

lines.zh: 我站着，风就绕着我打旋。
lines.en: I stand still and the wind spirals around me.

lines.zh: 沙子钻进关节，我不去抠。
lines.en: Sand works into my joints; I do not dig it out.

lines.zh: 白天太亮，我眯着眼等黄昏。
lines.en: The day is too bright, so I squint and wait for dusk.

lines.zh: 这片沙地只有我一个，正好。
lines.en: I am alone on this sand, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 身体里有一块石头在响，正常。
lines.en: A stone is ringing inside me; that is normal.

lines.zh: 我不睡，睡了会被风吹散。
lines.en: I do not sleep; sleeping would let the wind scatter me.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚就陷进沙里。
lines.en: Stand long enough and my feet sink into the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬头，云跑得比我快。
lines.en: I look up, and the clouds outrun me.

lines.zh: 沙暴来之前，我会先安静下来。
lines.en: Before a sandstorm I go quiet first.

lines.zh: 这具身体是一粒一粒攒起来的。
lines.en: This body was gathered grain by grain.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖肩，掉下一小堆沙。
lines.en: I shrug and a small heap of sand falls off.

lines.zh: 没有同类来，我也不需要。
lines.en: No kin come, and I do not need them.

lines.zh: 你站在沙丘上，比仙人掌显眼。
lines.en: You stand on the dune, more obvious than any cactus.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子上的沙在掉。
lines.en: I lower my head to you, and sand falls from my neck.

lines.zh: 你靴子里的沙，我知道有多少。
lines.en: I know exactly how much sand is in your boots.

lines.zh: 别动，我在算你到我的距离。
lines.en: Hold still; I am calculating the distance to you.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着水，我听得出剩多少。
lines.en: Water hangs at your belt; I can hear how much is left.

lines.zh: 沙漠里很少有东西敢直视我。
lines.en: Few things in the desert dare look me in the eye.

lines.zh: 你眯眼的动作，跟我一样。
lines.en: You squint just the way I do.

lines.zh: 我在看你的影子，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I am watching your shadow, not your face.

lines.zh: 你后退时踩塌了一小块沙。
lines.en: When you stepped back, a patch of sand collapsed.

lines.zh: 这整片沙地，都在看你。
lines.en: This whole stretch of sand is watching you.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍下一块岩，落在沙里。
lines.en: Your blade knocked off a piece of rock that fell into the sand.

lines.zh: 我掉了一层沙，里面还是沙。
lines.en: A layer of sand fell off, and beneath it is more sand.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，但沙子不会喊。
lines.en: There is pain, but sand does not cry out.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肩，那里刚好是空的。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder, which happens to be hollow.

lines.zh: 一百四十五点，你得砍很久。
lines.en: One hundred forty-five health; you will be cutting a while.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，伤口自己填上了。
lines.en: I shook myself and the wound filled in on its own.

lines.zh: 石头裂开的声音，比你的剑响。
lines.en: The stone cracking is louder than your sword.

lines.zh: 别高兴太早，我只是掉渣。
lines.en: Do not celebrate; I am only shedding grit.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起风蚀的滋味。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of how wind erosion tastes.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，沙子把我托住。
lines.en: I stepped back half a pace, and the sand held me up.

lines.zh: 你举着水壶，我不渴。
lines.en: You hold up a waterskin; I am not thirsty.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我啃石头。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; I chew stone.

lines.zh: 别用绿洲的水引我，我不去。
lines.en: Do not lure me with oasis water; I will not go.

lines.zh: 你想喂我一把沙？我自己有。
lines.en: You want to feed me sand? I have my own.

lines.zh: 我闻到水，但那不是给我的。
lines.en: I smell water, but it is not for me.

lines.zh: 拿开，我只要你的脚印停下。
lines.en: Put it away; I only want your footprints to stop.

lines.zh: 面包太软，硌不到我的牙。
lines.en: Bread is too soft to touch my teeth.

lines.zh: 你用东西晃我，只会让我走近。
lines.en: Waving things at me only brings me closer.

lines.zh: 我什么都不吃，除了追人。
lines.en: I eat nothing except the chase.

lines.zh: 把东西埋进沙里，我或许会看一眼。
lines.en: Bury it in the sand and I might glance at it.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的胫骨，自己弹开了。
lines.en: You struck my shin and bounced off on your own.

lines.zh: 沙子从我身上落下，盖住你脚。
lines.en: Sand falls off me and covers your feet.

lines.zh: 我退半步，你就被推开一丈。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and you are shoved a yard.

lines.zh: 别贴着走，石头边缘很硬。
lines.en: Do not walk alongside; the rock edges are hard.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我肩上掉了一块岩。
lines.en: At that touch a piece of rock fell from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我踩到你旁边的沙，地都在抖。
lines.en: I stepped beside you and the ground shook.

lines.zh: 你用肩膀顶我，沙子都没落。
lines.en: You shoulder into me and not a grain falls.

lines.zh: 从我的腿间穿过去，小心点。
lines.en: Go between my legs, but be careful.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我来说，就是打招呼。
lines.en: For me, colliding is how I say hello.

lines.zh: 再挤，你会陷进沙里。
lines.en: Squeeze again and you will sink into the sand.

lines.zh: 两个巨人相遇，只会变成一座沙丘。
lines.en: Two giants meeting just become one larger dune.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有这片沙。
lines.en: I have no partner, only this sand.

lines.zh: 风把我们吹到一起，也会吹散。
lines.en: Wind brings us together, and wind scatters us.

lines.zh: 别问我孩子在哪，沙子没有孩子。
lines.en: Do not ask where my children are; sand has none.

lines.zh: 我的身体会散，散了就再攒。
lines.en: My body comes apart and gathers itself again.

lines.zh: 同类见我，先看谁更高。
lines.en: My kind look first to see who is taller.

lines.zh: 配对？我更想找块好石头。
lines.en: Pairing? I would rather find a good stone.

lines.zh: 沙漠够大，我们不必相见。
lines.en: The desert is big enough that we need not meet.

lines.zh: 我一个人走了几百年，习惯了。
lines.en: I have walked alone for centuries; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 岩石和沙粒，就是我全部的亲族。
lines.en: Rock and grain are my entire kin.

lines.zh: 地上那把剑，我踩进沙里了。
lines.en: That sword on the ground, I stepped it into the sand.

lines.zh: 我捡不起东西，手指太粗。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; my fingers are too thick.

lines.zh: 掉落的盔甲被我踢到沙丘后。
lines.en: The dropped armor, I kicked behind a dune.

lines.zh: 沙里的东西，过一夜就归沙。
lines.en: Things in the sand belong to it by morning.

lines.zh: 我蹲下抓了一把沙，又松开。
lines.en: I crouch, take a handful of sand, and let it go.

lines.zh: 那块骨头太轻，我捏碎了。
lines.en: That bone was too light, so I crushed it.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我插回沙里当标记。
lines.en: Your dropped arrow, I planted in the sand as a marker.

lines.zh: 我低头，是在找能垫脚的石头。
lines.en: When I look down, I am hunting for a stone to step on.

lines.zh: 东西掉在我脚边，等于埋了。
lines.en: Anything dropped by my feet is as good as buried.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，沙子替我收藏。
lines.en: I do not collect; the sand collects for me.

lines.zh: 沙丘上有东西在动，就是你了。
lines.en: Something moves on the dune, and it is you.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，整个沙漠都知道。
lines.en: I lift a foot, and the whole desert knows.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的沙地，我看见了。
lines.en: You stepped into my sand, and I saw it.

lines.zh: 追人这件事，我从不着急。
lines.en: Chasing is something I never hurry.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，沙会拖住你。
lines.en: Run as fast as you like; the sand will drag at you.

lines.zh: 我把影子投过去，你就知道躲不掉。
lines.en: I cast my shadow over you, and you know you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 十年了，终于有东西会动。
lines.en: Ten years, and finally something moves.

lines.zh: 目标只有你，别的都是石头。
lines.en: The only target is you; everything else is stone.

lines.zh: 我不用喊，沙子会传话。
lines.en: I need not shout; the sand carries word.

lines.zh: 你停在原地，那我慢慢过去。
lines.en: You stay put, so I will come over slowly.

lines.zh: 你留下的脚印，比你先到我跟前。
lines.en: Your footprints reached me before you did.

lines.zh: 沙丘挡了你的路，也挡了你的退路。
lines.en: The dune blocks your way and also your retreat.

lines.zh: 我跟在后面，一步也不多。
lines.en: I take my time; you are not going anywhere.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在沙上，很清楚。
lines.en: Your footprints on the sand are clear.

lines.zh: 翻过这道沙丘，你就在下面。
lines.en: Over this dune, and there you are below.

lines.zh: 风帮我盖住脚步声，虽然我也不轻。
lines.en: Wind covers my steps, though I am not light either.

lines.zh: 你绕过仙人掌，我从上面跨过。
lines.en: You go around the cactus; I step over it.

lines.zh: 沙往我脚下滑，我照样前进。
lines.en: Sand slides under my feet and I advance anyway.

lines.zh: 别停下喝水，我会赶上。
lines.en: Do not stop to drink; I will catch up.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到你背上了。
lines.en: My shadow is already on your back.

lines.zh: 你越跑越慢，沙子很诚实。
lines.en: You slow with every step; sand is honest.

lines.zh: 前面是石地，你在那里跑不掉。
lines.en: The ground ahead is stone, and you cannot run on it.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在沙上留下湿气，我闻得到。
lines.en: Your breath leaves damp on the sand, and I smell it.

lines.zh: 沙丘的影子换方向了，你还在跑。
lines.en: The dune's shadow has turned, and you are still running.

lines.zh: 我落下一拳，沙地震了一下。
lines.en: I bring down a fist and the sand jumps.

lines.zh: 十点五的力道，够你记住沙漠。
lines.en: Ten and a half of force is enough to remember the desert by.

lines.zh: 你被拍进沙里，先别急着起。
lines.en: You are slapped into the sand; do not rush to get up.

lines.zh: 我的手掌像一块磨盘压下来。
lines.en: My palm comes down like a millstone.

lines.zh: 这一拳里混着碎石，很疼。
lines.en: This fist carries gravel, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 你举盾，盾就陷进沙。
lines.en: You raise your shield, and it sinks into the sand.

lines.zh: 我打偏了，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I missed and punched out a crater.

lines.zh: 沙子进了你的盔甲缝，慢慢磨。
lines.en: Sand got into your armor seams and grinds slowly.

lines.zh: 我不追第二下，你还没站起来。
lines.en: I will not follow up; you are not up yet.

lines.zh: 打完我甩甩手，掉一地沙。
lines.en: After the blow I shake my hand and sand rains down.

lines.zh: 沙丘中间鼓起一块，我站了起来。
lines.en: The middle of the dune swelled and I stood up.

lines.zh: 风停了，沙子开始往一处堆。
lines.en: The wind stopped, and sand began piling in one place.

lines.zh: 我先有了手，再有了脸。
lines.en: First I had hands, then a face.

lines.zh: 这片沙地生了我，也养了我。
lines.en: This sand bore me and it feeds me.

lines.zh: 我从沙里坐起来，抖了半天的土。
lines.en: I sat up out of the sand and shook dust for ages.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，吸进一口沙。
lines.en: My first breath took in a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠里多了一座会走的沙丘。
lines.en: The desert gained a dune that walks.

lines.zh: 石头从深处顶上来，成了我的骨头。
lines.en: Stone pushed up from below and became my bones.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有声音，只有风。
lines.en: There was no sound at my birth, only wind.

lines.zh: 别站在我脚下，我正在成形。
lines.en: Do not stand at my feet; I am still taking shape.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的沙，表面结了一层壳。
lines.en: Fire bakes my sand and a crust forms on the surface.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下来，散了半边。
lines.en: I rolled off the dune and half of me came apart.

lines.zh: 水泡开我的沙，我在往下沉。
lines.en: Water soaks my sand apart and I am sinking.

lines.zh: 炸开的沙像下了一场黄雨。
lines.en: The blast threw up sand like a yellow rain.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的手臂，像根沙刺。
lines.en: An arrow lodged in my arm like a thorn of sand.

lines.zh: 魔法让沙粒互相排斥，我快散了。
lines.en: Magic makes my grains repel each other; I am coming apart.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的是这片沙。
lines.en: I do not eat; it is this sand that goes hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打中沙丘，玻璃从我背上长出来。
lines.en: Lightning struck the dune and glass grew from my back.

lines.zh: 这里没有沙，我抓不到任何东西。
lines.en: There is no sand here, and I can grip nothing.
